Nine canonical migration receipts re-verified through receipt:verify with their aggregate linkage checked.

entryPointFinding.what: receipt:verify is not the verification entry point for the sixteen dedicated-schema receipts.
entryPointFinding.detail: Running receipt:verify over the enterprise report's 27-receipt inventory passes on the 11 receipts whose schema the dispatcher knows and throws `Receipt schema missing runId` / `invalid migration.file` on the other 16, because those receipts carry their own schema and their own verifier. Each of those 16 verifies green through its own verifier, which is what this unit ran and what the node suite runs. This is an operator-surface sharpness finding, not a portfolio red: no cell is unverified.
entryPointFinding.evidence: 11 pass / 16 schema-dispatch refusals through receipt:verify; 16/16 pass through their own verifiers.

fmtFinding.severity: named, not patched — the packet forbids product code changes and evidence patching, and the fix is impossible under the freeze
fmtFinding.whatHappened: pnpm exec vp fmt exited 2 and, before failing, rewrote 249 committed source files in place. Every one of those writes was reverted with git checkout -- packages/, and the tracked tree is byte-clean again (verified: git status reports no modified tracked file).

twoDistinctCauses.explanation: Thirteen untracked files under .claude/worktrees/*/docs/goals/react-angular-migration-spine/state.yaml fail to parse (SyntaxError: Invalid escape sequence \]). These are other agent sessions' git worktrees living inside this host tree. They are not repository content and do not exist in a clean checkout, which is why u1 recorded fmt green there. Not a repository defect.

Measured independently and without writing, using pnpm exec vp fmt --list-different: 249 committed repository source files are not in this formatter's canonical form. This is a real repository-state fact and it is NOT caused by the .claude parse errors. It also means the fmt gate as historically invoked never asserted canonical formatting — vp fmt defaults to --write, so it silently rewrites and still exits 0, which is how a green fmt has been recorded.

fmtFinding.whyItCannotBeFixedHere: 82 of the 249 files are inside the frozen adapter subtrees (74 under packages/frameworks/angular, 8 under packages/frameworks/react). Committing a reformat of those files changes the frozen tree oids and therefore the freeze composite 27741d9c. Under this freeze the formatting cannot be brought to canonical form, so this is reported as a stop-class finding for the release candidate rather than repaired.
fmtFinding.recommendedGateForm: pnpm exec vp fmt --check (or --list-different) with .claude and .fable-opus ignored, so the gate asserts formatting instead of performing it.

hygiene.note: vp fmt's in-place writes were the only writes outside this unit's file contract; they were reverted in full and the tracked tree is clean.

packProvenanceFinding.severity: STOP CONDITION for the release candidate — a source/evidence-level defect, not staging, and not patched here
packProvenanceFinding.headline: The committed trust package attests a distribution inventory that HEAD does not produce. `vp pack` at HEAD necessarily invalidates `trust:verify`.
packProvenanceFinding.howItSurfaced: This unit ran the packet-listed `pnpm exec vp pack` gate at 05:44. It exited 0. Every gate that reads the distribution inventory went red immediately afterwards: `trust:verify --offline` now throws `Provenance subjects differ from the exact distribution inventory`, and 3 of the 2476 node tests fail (packages/cli/test/operator-flows.test.ts: `operator verify > summarises the offline checks and recomputes the frozen subtrees`, and both `operator supported-matrix` cases).

theEvidence.laterSourceCommit: ed39ccd at 05:01 changed packages/cli/src/** (framework-neutral operator flows) and is an ancestor of HEAD dcd991e
theEvidence.consequence: provenance.json therefore records dist bytes built BEFORE ed39ccd, while HEAD contains ed39ccd. No build of HEAD can reproduce them.
theEvidence.subjectComparison: 7 of the 11 provenance subjects differ from a HEAD build; 4 reproduce byte-exactly (packages/experiments, frameworks/angularjs, frameworks/nextjs, node-guard). The recorded chunk packages/cli/dist/verify-CaJ2OPHR.js does not exist; a HEAD build emits verify-B7NXJ3SC.js.
theEvidence.packIsDeterministic: vp pack was run twice; both runs produced byte-identical dist output (cli.js 48040241, cli/index.js 8e5feacb, core 2ca9afd3, trust 4878de2e, react 5515304e, angular f1a8b653). The build is reproducible — it simply does not reproduce what the trust package attests.
theEvidence.whyItPassedBefore: Until 05:44 the pre-ed39ccd dist bytes were still sitting in the gitignored packages/*/dist directories on this host, so trust:verify was verifying stale build output rather than a reproducible artifact. dist/ is gitignored, so those bytes are not in the repository and could not be restored by git.

packProvenanceFinding.honestCost: This unit destroyed the only copy of the attested bytes by running the pack gate. They are unrecoverable on this host. `trust:verify --offline` and the 3 operator-flow tests are RED at the close of this unit and were green at 05:22, before the pack gate ran. Both measurements are recorded above and below with their times; neither is withdrawn.
packProvenanceFinding.whatWasNotDone: No evidence was patched to hide this. The trust package was NOT regenerated: `trust:generate` would re-attest the reproducible HEAD dist and make the gates green again, but it changes the trust digest 213b43e8, the enterprise-report bindings and the derived-matrix source digest — a Judge-level decision about the release candidate, not a worker action.
packProvenanceFinding.recommendedResolution: Rebuild (`vp pack`) and regenerate the trust package at HEAD, then re-record the trust digest and the enterprise/matrix bindings, and add a gate ordering rule: the trust package must be generated after the build it attests, and re-generated whenever packages/*/src changes.

releaseCandidateVerdict.reason: Two stop-class findings are open: packProvenanceFinding (the trust package attests non-reproducible dist bytes) and fmtFinding (249 committed files are not in canonical format, 82 of them inside the frozen subtrees). The ten-cell portfolio itself is green with no stale, skipped, ambiguous or red cell.
